description: Skill routing rules — single source of truth for trigger pattern matching (Issue #5540, #5902, #6352, #7411)

rules.disambiguation: Explain UE concepts and assets. CVar queries ('r.X 뭐야') should route to ue-cvar-explorer. Issue queries should route to issue-find or issue-snapshot. Queries with explicit '#N' issue references should route to issue-snapshot (single-issue 3-question snapshot) not ue-explain.
Change impact analysis and cross-references
Error resolution and debugging (includes audio/MetaSound debugging, not 'auto fix warnings' which is ue-audit, not 'error test/mystery' which is build-error-mystery-test)
Compile/build error resolution (specific). For general debugging/crashes, use ue-debug instead.

Cross-domain system generation (C++ + BP + VFX + Material + UI) via NarshaMCP analysis + Editor RC creation. Requires 'system' qualifier with domain qualifier (VFX/UI/Material). For single-feature creation, use ue-scaffold instead.
Feature scaffolding with architecture design + code generation

Project-wide health diagnostic. Level-scoped health (레벨 건강 / streaming + DataLayer diagnose) routes to ue-level-analysis, not the project-wide audit. Scored trace-quality/runtime performance audit of a .utrace routes to ue-perf-audit.
Asset quality validation (not project audit, not issue goal verification)
CVar/config exploration with engine metadata. Broad search queries ('모든 설정 찾아') should use ue_grep instead.
Live Coding / Hot Reload failure recovery
Pre-commit safety check for staged C++ changes (incl. Phase 6 test-intent suggestion)
Cross-check mismatches + entity/asset diff: replication audit, class hierarchy delta, config override cascade, binary .uasset compare
UE test framework auto-selection advisor (Phase 0). Recommends framework then routes to ue-test-gen, ue-automation-test-builder, or ue-test-scenario. Not direct test generation.
One-shot UE Automation Test generation (also intent-based multi-test mode, Issue #10283)
Game design intelligence documents (GAS balance, AI behavior)
On-demand engine PDB/metadata loading workflow
Build, evaluate, and maintain MCP-powered skills (not UE feature creation)
Level Sequence cinematics workflow (structure, tracks, keyframes, playback)
IK Rig structure analysis (not Control Rig)
Static code analysis for PERF rules. For runtime profiling, use ue-insights-profiler.
Static architecture rule checking (ARCH-001~010). For performance: ue-perf-lint. For pre-commit impact: ue-pre-commit. For project health: ue-audit.
Performance profiling with Unreal Insights (not general debugging). Scored trace-quality + runtime audit of a capture routes to ue-perf-audit.

Project infrastructure (WP/DDC/SC), not git/commit operations. Level-content analysis (레벨 분석 / OFPA actor placement, per-level composition) belongs to ue-level-analysis, not project-level WP/DDC status.
Asset reference/dependency discovery (not asset validation or search)
Blueprint/GAS execution flow tracing (not impact analysis or debugging)
UE engine source build (not project build → ue-build-automate)
Build/cook/package pipeline automation (not build error fixing)
C++ refactoring operations (not new class creation or scaffolding)
First-session project analysis and tool/skill recommendation (not project ops/WP/DDC, not audit/health)
CI status check and issue goal verification (not debugging or auditing)
Find actionable GitHub issues by priority/component (not issue creation or CI check)
Cyclic build error diagnosis accuracy testing (not debugging real errors)
MCP server live testing (build + mock E2E + editor + live calls), not code review or issue verification
PR creation with quality gate enforcement and CI monitoring (not code review or CI check)
Post-merge cleanup (verify merge, clean issue/branch/untracked, switch to main). Not for pre-merge review or full-cycle.
Generate persistent project context files for auto-loading in future sessions (not onboarding/recommendations)
Auto-generate progressive disclosure project structure docs (L0-L3). Not project-init (domain context), not module-analyzer (engine docs), not module-mapper (linker errors).
End-to-end issue lifecycle (plan → implement → test → review → PR → CI → cleanup). Not individual steps.
UE C++ dev loop (code → build → fix → test). Not internal full-cycle. Not scaffolding only (ue-scaffold).
Goal-based test generation and verification for issues. Not edge case hunting (test-iterate) or UE automation test creation (ue-automation-test-builder).
UE Automation Test 6-Phase iterative creation for game code. Not one-shot test gen (ue-test-gen). Not issue-based verification (issue-test-verify).
Natural language scenario to Complex+Latent automation test (Issue #6798)
Release workflow (version bump + changelog + git + GitHub Release + Confluence). Not for release testing (use release-package-tester) or deploy (use deploy-test).
Multi-tool Control Rig orchestration: batch audit, A/B comparison, C++ integration (not IK Rig, not single-tool operations)
PIE input recording → C++ automation test (Issue #6799). Not scenario-based (ue-test-scenario) or function-based (ue-test-gen).
Run MCP E2E headless tests with auto GitHub issue creation on failure. For MCP live testing use mcp-live-test.
Compatibility alias for idle-scout. For queued issue fixing use idle-resolve; for PR decision queues use idle-review-harvest; for operational improvement analysis use idle-analyst.

Summarize Resolver-created Draft PRs for human decision. Does not create fixes or merge.
Analyze Scout/Resolver/Review Harvester runtime evidence and improvement candidates. Does not run stages or mutate GitHub unless --create-issues.

Discovery-only idle Scout. Creates queued issues only; no branches or PRs.
Multi-platform Gauntlet smoke/soak/performance test orchestration via RunUAT (not build pipeline or error fixing)
Launch Unreal Editor process (not project health check or audit)
Create/prepare GitHub issue with labels, assignee, branch. Not issue discovery (issue-find) or execution start (issue-start). Title-input case auto-invokes /issue-review (Issue #11418).
Full issue execution workflow (setup + plan + review loop). Not issue creation (issue-setup) or issue discovery (issue-find).
Manual goal-based verification with code review and tests. Not CI status check (ci-verify) or issue discovery (issue-find).
Issue state consistency check and fix (branch-label, resolved prereqs, stale). Not issue discovery (issue-find) or creation (issue-setup).
Iterative edge case hunting until N consecutive clean passes. Not one-shot test gen (ue-test-gen) or simple test run (test-run).
Smart test execution (quick/verify/full modes). Not iterative edge case hunting (test-iterate) or test generation (ue-test-gen).
Plan/design review using past lessons (636 lessons). Not scaffolding (ue-scaffold) or impact analysis (ue-impact).

Blueprint execution flow analysis (not creation=blueprint-generator, not conversion=bp-to-cpp, not eval=bp-flow-comprehension-eval, not refactoring=ue-refactor-bp)
BP flow comprehension evaluation with blind protocol (not BP flow tracing which is blueprint-flow)
Validate BP→C++ migration completeness. NOT: logic conversion (bp-to-cpp), NOT: project infrastructure (bp-cpp-project-init).
Long-running CI monitoring with polling loop (not one-shot CI status check which is ci-verify, not skill integrity check which is ci-monitor-self-test)
Single C++ class generation (not multi-class system=code-generation-power, not feature scaffolding=ue-scaffold)
NarshaMCP codebase self-analysis and issue creation (not UE project audit which is ue-audit)
Confluence manual page screenshot capture and upload (not general Confluence updates)
Static network replication audit (source analysis). For per-line anti-pattern scanning use ue-network-lint. For runtime performance profiling use ue-insights-profiler.
Per-line network anti-pattern scanning (NET-001~010 rules). For replication health overview and bandwidth estimation use ue-network-audit.
Per-line security vulnerability scanning (SEC-001~012: trust boundaries, data exposure, secrets, supply chain). For network correctness use ue-network-lint. For performance use ue-perf-lint.
UE engine version migration (scan deprecated APIs/configs/assets, generate report, auto-fix). Not for data/DB migration or CL tracking (/ue-cl-tracker).

en: what will break if I change

rules.disambiguation: Refactoring safety — answers 'Can I rename/delete this safely?' with full caller/override/delegate analysis. For general call graph understanding, use execution-flow-explorer.
Bidirectional call graph for code understanding — callers AND callees with Mermaid. For refactoring safety (rename/delete), use caller-graph-visualizer.

Single GAS ability development — tag/ability/attribute analysis and flow tracing. For full Input→Ability→Animation chain, use cross-domain-flow. For balance reports, use game-design-intelligence. For animation/montage queries (even with GA references), use animation-workflow.
GAS-aware deep execution chain: Input→InputTag→Ability→Blueprint→C++→Animation. For single GAS analysis without cross-domain tracing, use gas-development.

Create NEW Blueprint graphs from natural language via the T3D pipeline (build_graph_guide → build_graph → import_t3d → compile). For analyzing existing BPs, use blueprint-flow. For C++ class creation, use ue-scaffold or code-generation.

Multi-class system generation (3-10 classes, 17 scenarios) via NarshaMCP analysis + Editor RC creation for BP/VFX/Input. For single class creation, use ue_generate_code(smart) or code-generation skill.
Material structure analysis with hierarchy, nodes, and performance metrics. For bulk material changes, use asset-modification-wizard.
Lighting setup automation — search, spawn, and configure lights. For material analysis, use material-analysis.
Multi-tool PCG orchestration (audit, batch, clone, migrate). For single PCG operations, use ue_manage_pcg directly.
.Build.cs dependency resolution for linker errors using UBT Manifest. For module structure analysis (headers, deps), use module-analyzer.
Analyze UE module structure (Build.cs, headers, deps) to generate OVERVIEW.md and CLASSES.md. For linker error resolution, use module-mapper.

Project-wide static health audit (BP complexity, C++ architecture, build time, Epic standards). For runtime .utrace profiling, use ue-insights-profiler. For diagnostic/audit, use ue-audit. For a scored trace-quality + runtime performance audit of a .utrace, use ue-perf-audit.
UE API change analyzer for version migration. Generates breaking changes and migration guides for engine upgrades.
Safe bulk asset modification (Discovery→Impact→Strategy→Dry-Run→Execute). For single asset changes, use MCP tools directly.
Analyze BP logic and generate equivalent C++ code. NOT: project infrastructure (bp-cpp-project-init), NOT: migration validation (bp-to-cpp-validator), NOT: BP analysis only (blueprint-flow).
Initialize C++ project structure (Source/, Build.cs, Target.cs) for BP-only projects. Does NOT convert BP logic to C++ (use bp-to-cpp for that).
Source-to-document cross-verification (8 claim types). For code review, use ns-review. For asset validation, use ue-validate.
Extract usage examples from UE engine code to generate EXAMPLES.md. For module analysis, use module-analyzer.
Generate TROUBLESHOOT.md from known issues and solutions. For active debugging, use ue-debug or unreal-error-doctor.
Interactive trace HTML visualization file. For trace analysis without HTML export, use blueprint-flow or ue-execution-trace.
Code review + safe auto-fixes (type hints, imports, whitespace). For iterative review to target score, use review-iterate. For code review only, use ns-review.
Iterate review-fix cycles until target score (default 9.0). For one-shot review+fix, use review-fix.
Deep MCP session readiness verification (server health + cache/index + editor ports). For project-wide audit, use ue-audit.
README.md SSOT cross-validation against Cargo.toml, CLAUDE.md, CHANGELOG.md. For source-to-doc verification, use source-doc-verify.
NarshaMCP live demo evidence refresh workflow. For MCP testing, use mcp-live-test.
Build and launch Narsha IDE (VSCode fork). For Unreal Editor launch, use ue-editor-launcher.
Automated project rebranding workflow (dry-run, validation, backup, rollback). For C++ class/function rename, use ue-cpp-refactor.
5-Phase release package testing (Pre-Flight→Extract→Reset→Build→MCP Test). For release automation, use release-automation. For MCP testing, use mcp-live-test.

Session progress dashboard (implementation/test/review/PR/CI status in one compact table). NOT project health audit (/ue-audit) or server health (/session-health-check) or project infrastructure (/ue-project-ops).
Epic AI toolset competitive tracking (daily ue5-main scan). NOT for: individual CL lookup (use ue-cl-tracker), general engine changes.
Community pain point scraper + competitive intelligence (Reddit/UE Forums for UE + AI assistant complaints and competitor monitoring). NOT for: Epic toolset tracking (use epic-toolset-tracker).

Blueprint-to-Blueprint refactoring (modify existing BP graph). NOT: analysis only (blueprint-flow), new BP creation (blueprint-generator), C++ refactoring (ue-cpp-refactor), BP-to-C++ logic conversion (bp-to-cpp), C++ project init (bp-cpp-project-init).
AI modification safety net with snapshot+rollback. NOT: rename (safe-class-rename), bulk asset modification (asset-modification-wizard), error fixing (ue-debug).
VCS revision-range diff with per-file structured analysis. NOT: entity diff (ue-diff), pre-commit safety (ue-pre-commit), hypothetical impact (ue-impact).
Find the right skill for a task via routing.json matching. NOT: creating/building skills (mcp-skill-builder), evaluating skills (ns-skills-evaluator).

Triage mirror repo (nextstage-dev/narsha-mcp) issues against main repo. Detects duplicates, resolved, new. NOT: issue discovery (issue-find), NOT: issue state fix (issue-update), NOT: issue creation (issue-setup).
Triage mirror repo PRs (code review, conflict check, cherry-pick). NOT: mirror issue triage (mirror-issue-triage), NOT: creating PRs (pr-create), NOT: PR review (ns-review).
Weekly token waste monitoring with WoW trends and regression alerts. NOT: explaining what tokens are (ue-explain).

Agent component (skill/hook/subagent) clean-environment testing framework via eval-channel. NOT: MCP live test (mcp-live-test), NOT: cargo/pytest (test-run), NOT: UE automation test generation (ue-test-gen), NOT: E2E nightly (mcp-e2e-nightly).

ADK roadmap epic issue creation from gap analysis. Delegates to epic-planner with ADK-specific defaults. NOT Epic Games tracking (use epic-toolset-tracker). NOT general issue search (use issue-find). NOT single issue creation (use issue-setup). NOT generic epic planning (use epic-planner).

Closed-loop auto-fix of failing UE Automation tests. Reads structured TestResult (Issue #7924), classifies compile/runtime/assertion, routes to ue_fix_errors, rebuilds, reruns. Different from /test-iterate (edge-case rotation) and /ue-dev-cycle (no test in inner loop). Not test generation (/ue-test-gen, /ue-automation-test-builder).

en: what can I work on here

rules.disambiguation: Triage matrix only. For actionable filtered list use /issue-find. For per-issue gate enforcement use /issue-start.

fallback.description: When no rule matches AND query is a high-level workflow request, search marketplace for relevant skills (Issue #5902)

positive: Natural language feature/workflow requests (e.g., 'help me with X', 'I want to X')
Domain keywords not covered by existing rules (e.g., 'networking', 'multiplayer', 'UI animation')
Multi-step guidance requests (e.g., 'how should I approach X', 'best practice for X')
negative: Specific file paths or text file extensions (already caught by STOP rule)
Simple data queries (e.g., 'list all blueprints', 'find asset X')
Queries that map directly to MCP-First table entries

search_strategy.extract_keywords: From user query, extract 1-3 domain keywords
search_strategy.present_results: Show top 1-3 skills with name, description, and install command. Note: available in next session after install.
